query: What is the most recent NIFC National Fire News year-to-date acres burned figure for 2026, latest available as of late June 2026? Report the exact YTD acres and date.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the key finding:

**The most recent NIFC national year-to-date acres-burned figure available as of late June 2026 is 3,168,102 acres burned as of June 30, 2026** (across 36,262 wildfires).

This comes directly from NIFC's **National Significant Wildland Fire Potential Outlook** (issued July 1, 2026 by Predictive Services/NICC), which states verbatim: *"As of June 30, 3,168,102 acres have burned across the country, which is 157% of the previous 10-year average. So far this year 36,262 wildfires have been reported, also above average, at 133%."*

**Key notes:**
- This end-of-June figure is the correct, precise, NIFC-sourced value for the requested "late June 2026" timeframe.
- The live NIFC statistics/national fire news pages update daily and now show later data (July 18: 3,853,513 acres YTD; July 17 IMSR: 3,716,104 acres), so they can't provide a late-June snapshot.
- A June 22 media figure of 152,399 acres (Deseret News) is *not* the YTD total — it refers only to acres actively burning on 31 large fires that day.
- 2026 tracked well above average all year (~1.5M acres by late March, ~2.4M by late May, ~2.3–2.5M by June 9–10), with a sharp acceleration in late June (National Preparedness Level rose to 4 on June 29).

key_facts: NIFC's National Significant Wildland Fire Potential Outlook (issued July 1, 2026) states: 'As of June 30, 3,168,102 acres have burned across the country' — the definitive end-of-June 2026 YTD acres figure.
36,262 wildfires had been reported year-to-date as of June 30, 2026.
The June 30 YTD acres total (3,168,102) was 157% of the previous 10-year average; the fire count was 133% of average.
The National Preparedness Level was raised to 3 on June 18 and to 4 on June 29, 2026, reflecting a sharp late-June acceleration in fire activity.
For trend context: ~1.5M acres by March 27, ~2.4M acres by late May, and ~2.3-2.5M acres by June 9-10, 2026 — all well above the 10-year average.
The live NIFC statistics/national fire news pages update daily and now show later data (July 18, 2026: 3,853,513 acres YTD); they cannot be used for a late-June snapshot.
The archived IMSR (sitreprt.pdf/day1.pdf) links rotate daily and currently resolve to the July 17, 2026 report showing 3,716,104 acres YTD as of July 17.
A June 22 Deseret News figure of 152,399 acres refers only to acres on 31 active large fires, not the cumulative national YTD total.
